details:
This update for cadvisor fixes the following issues:

Changes in cadvisor:

- update to 0.60.6:
  * workflows: mirror release tags to lib/ module tags
  * fs/zfs: fall back to VFS when zfs stats are unavailable
  * storage/stdout: nil-check Cpu, Network, and Memory stats
  * Treat memory-only NUMA nodes as valid topology
- update vendor.tar to fix
  * bsc#1283657, CVE-2026-63209: cadvisor:
    github.com/klauspost/compress: signed integer overflow in
    s2.NewDict()
